description: This Java source file defines the TaxRatesController class, which manages CRUD operations and view handling for tax rate entities within a web application's administrative interface. It uses Spring MVC annotations and integrates with various service classes to perform business logic related to tax rates.

classes.name: TaxRatesController
classes.description: Controller handling the web interface for managing tax rates, including listing, pagination, creation, editing, and removal of tax rate entries, with role-based access control.

methods.name: displayTaxRates
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of tax rates along with supporting data such as countries and tax classes.

methods.name: pageTaxRates
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a paginated list of tax rates in JSON format.

methods.name: saveTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new tax rate after validation.

methods.name: updateTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing tax rate after validation.

methods.name: removeTaxRate
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a tax rate by ID, returning JSON response.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Handles GET request to load a tax rate for editing, returning the view with pre-filled data.

methods.name: validateTaxRate
methods.description: Performs validation on the TaxRate object, ensuring fields are correct and consistent.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu structure and active menu items for the views.
